# Sendora Gift

Sendora Gift is a B2B corporate gifting service operated by Shenzhen Gelinhong Technology Co., Ltd.

## Company focus
- Custom corporate gift sets
- Employee welcome kits
- Client appreciation gifts
- Conference and trade show gifts
- Custom logo products and branded packaging

## Buyer support
Sendora Gift helps procurement teams, HR teams, event organizers and promotional product buyers plan product combinations, logo branding, packaging, samples and international delivery.
